item.description:
The music video for the song was directed by British director Nigel Dick between 18–19 January 1996 in Gorbio, France and released in February 1996. It begins in a small village. Dion plays a woman who belongs to a group of circus artists. She gets flowers on the door of her carriage, from a little boy. He obviously delivers them for a man. The card says "Bonne chance (Good luck)". Dion, now holding the flowers, begins to sing. Then she sits at the dressing table in front of a mirror. A clown helps her put on a long-haired wig. In evening, the circus is performing in front of a crowd of people. Various artists perform, while the singer stands leaning against a stone wall. Obviously sad, while she sings. Then a fire artist comes on stage and Dion assists him with handing him torchs, while he performs. In one scene, she reaches him one of them, but instead, he takes another. Dion runs off in the dark, driving away in a car. The video ends with her driving in a winding mountainside in daylight. There she meets a motorcyclist who is obviously waiting for her. Then they embrace each other. The video was uploaded to YouTube in 2011. In August 2020, it has got more than 11,700,000 views. In March 2021, the video has been remastered in HD quality to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the album's release.

这首歌的音乐录影带由英国导演奈杰尔·迪克（Nigel Dick）执导，于1996年1月18日至19日在法国戈尔比奥（Gorbio）拍摄，并于1996年2月发行。开场是在一个小村庄。席琳·迪翁饰演一位属于马戏团艺人团队的女子。她在自己的马车门口收到了一束花，由一个小男孩送来。显然，这花是某个男子托他送的。卡片上写着“Bonne chance（祝你好运）”。迪翁手捧鲜花，开始唱歌。随后，她坐在梳妆台前，对着镜子化妆。一位小丑帮她戴上长发假发。

夜幕降临，马戏团在观众面前开始表演。各种艺人轮番登场，而迪翁靠在一堵石墙旁边演唱，神情忧伤。接着，一位喷火艺人上场表演，迪翁在一旁协助，递给他火把。在其中一个镜头中，她递出一支火把，但那位艺人却拿了另一支。迪翁随即转身跑入黑暗之中，驾车离开。影片的结尾，她在白昼里驾驶着汽车，沿着蜿蜒的山路行驶。最终，她遇见了一位显然在等她的摩托车手，两人相拥。

这支音乐录影带于2011年上传至YouTube，截至2020年8月，播放量已超过1170万次。

2021年3月，为庆祝这张专辑发行25周年，该视频重新以高清格式修复发布。
